|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[I've Decided To Go Back (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image on this page show this text. No published image shows the errata text; [[I've Decided To Go Back (V) (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB6-97-Ive_Decided_To_Go_Back-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet and the revised Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “Use 1 Force to ▼ (or retrieve) Panaka, Ric Olie, or non-[Virtual] Amidala. OR If your ability = 3 character defending a battle alone at a site (except Senate), character is power +2, adds one destiny to power, and may draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. [Immune to Sense]”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref><ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; revised copy, PDF dated 20 April 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 34). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[I've Decided To Go Back (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[I've Decided To Go Back (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 12 December 2012) moved “non-[Virtual] Amidala” to the front of the list, changed “adds one destiny to power, and” to “adds one destiny to power and” and “if unable to” to “if not able to” (the card list writes the ▼ and Immune to Sense icons out): “Use 1 Force to deploy (or retrieve) non-[Virtual] Amidala, Panaka, or Ric Olie from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If your ability = 3 character defending a battle alone at a site (except Senate), character is power +2, adds one destiny to power and may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. (Immune to Sense.)”.<ref name="cl-1261_96-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive)</ref>
